title: Flood advisory: Pantal River above normal
for_households: Move vehicles and valuables to higher floors. Prepare a go-bag. Residents of riverside zones in Bonuan and Pantal should be ready to go to the nearest evacuation center if the river rises further.
for_schools: Keep classes in session but prepare to dismiss early if the advisory is upgraded. Do not use ground-floor rooms near the river.
for_farmers: Clear field drains and fishpond outlets. Harvest mature crops in low-lying plots near the river.
for_barangay_officials: The Pantal River dike is still unfinished. Station a watcher at the open section and pre-position sandbags.

title: Yellow rainfall warning
for_households: Flooding is possible in low-lying streets. Monitor updates every 3 hours.
for_schools: No change to schedules.
for_farmers: Hold off on fertilizer application until the rain eases.
for_barangay_officials: Check that canals in flood-prone puroks are clear.

title: Coastal flooding: 1.4 m high tide at 6:40 PM
for_households: Expect ankle- to knee-deep water in Longos, Tonsuya and Tañong this evening. Raise appliances and move vehicles before 6 PM.
for_schools: End afternoon classes by 4:30 PM in affected barangays.
for_farmers: Fishpond operators should close sluice gates before high tide.
for_barangay_officials: Two flood sensors are offline. Post manual watchers at the Tullahan wall gap and the Longos outfall.

title: Flood advisory: Tullahan River
for_households: Riverside residents in Tinajeros should keep go-bags ready.
for_schools: No change to schedules.
for_farmers: Not applicable in urban barangays.
for_barangay_officials: Check the temporary sandbag line at the river wall gap.

title: Heat index 36°C (Extreme Caution)
for_households: Drink water often and limit time outdoors from 11 AM to 3 PM. Check on older neighbors.
for_schools: Move PE and outdoor activities to early morning.
for_farmers: Irrigate urban gardens early or late in the day.
for_barangay_officials: Open covered courts as cooling spots. The shaded bikeway network is only half finished.

title: Orange rainfall warning
for_households: Flooding is threatening. Residents near the Yawa River and lahar channels should prepare to evacuate.
for_schools: Suspend afternoon classes in barangays along lahar channels.
for_farmers: Move livestock to higher ground. Delay planting in low fields.
for_barangay_officials: The Yawa River lahar dike extension has not started. Pre-evacuate households in the unprotected section.

title: Gale warning: eastern seaboard
for_households: Coastal residents should secure boats and loose roofing.
for_schools: No change to schedules.
for_farmers: Fisherfolk should not go out to sea in small boats.
for_barangay_officials: The storm-surge embankment's city segment is still incomplete. Review evacuation lists for coastal barangays.

title: Thunderstorm advisory
for_households: Heavy rain for 1–2 hours. Avoid crossing flooded streets in Jaro and La Paz.
for_schools: Delay dismissal until the storm passes.
for_farmers: Check drainage in rice paddies near the floodway.
for_barangay_officials: The Jaro floodway needs desilting. Watch the La Paz low points, where the pumping station is delayed.

title: Thunderstorm advisory: upstream rain
for_households: Rain upstream can raise the Cagayan de Oro River fast. Riverside residents should stay alert tonight.
for_schools: No change to schedules.
for_farmers: Avoid crossing the river with livestock.
for_barangay_officials: River telemetry upgrade is delayed. Use manual staff-gauge readings and radio relays.

title: Heat index 31°C (Caution)
for_households: Stay hydrated during midday.
for_schools: No change to schedules.
for_farmers: Water crops early in the day.
for_barangay_officials: No action needed beyond routine monitoring.

title: Flood advisory: low-lying Tondo and Sampaloc
for_households: Expect knee-deep water on España Boulevard and in low streets of Tondo. Move valuables to higher floors and keep go-bags ready.
for_schools: Prepare to dismiss early in Sampaloc and Tondo if the advisory is upgraded.
for_farmers: Not applicable in urban barangays.
for_barangay_officials: The España drainage work and the Baseco seawall are unfinished. Post watchers at the low points and pre-position sandbags.

title: Coastal flooding: 1.3 m high tide at 7:10 PM
for_households: Shoreline households in Baseco and Isla Puting Bato should raise appliances and move vehicles before 6 PM.
for_schools: End afternoon classes by 4:30 PM in shoreline barangays.
for_farmers: Small fishing boats should stay moored until the tide drops.
for_barangay_officials: Check that the Roxas Boulevard flap gates close as the tide rises.

title: Flood watch: Cagayan River basin
for_households: Riverside households in Caggay, Linao and Pengue-Ruyu should keep go-bags ready and watch the river level at Buntun Bridge.
for_schools: No change to schedules.
for_farmers: Harvest mature corn in riverside fields if possible.
for_barangay_officials: The Pinacanauan bank protection in Caggay is unfinished. Review evacuation lists for riverbank households.

title: Heat index 38°C (Extreme Caution)
for_households: Drink water often and limit time outdoors from 11 AM to 3 PM. Check on older neighbors.
for_schools: Move PE and outdoor activities to early morning.
for_farmers: Work in the fields early or late in the day.
for_barangay_officials: Open covered courts as cooling spots.

title: Orange rainfall warning

for_schools: Suspend afternoon classes in riverside barangays.
for_farmers: Move livestock to higher ground. Delay planting in low fields.
for_barangay_officials: The Bicol River dike in Mabolo is unfinished. Pre-evacuate households along the low section. The Bicol River gauge is offline; read the manual staff gauge.

title: Heat index 32°C (Caution)
for_households: Stay hydrated during midday.
for_schools: No change to schedules.
for_farmers: Water crops early in the day.
for_barangay_officials: No action needed beyond routine monitoring.

title: Yellow rainfall warning
for_households: Flooding is possible in low-lying streets and along creeks. Monitor updates every 3 hours.
for_schools: No change to schedules.
for_farmers: Check drainage in upland farms in Buhisan and Busay.
for_barangay_officials: Two creek sensors are offline. Post watchers at the Lahug and Guadalupe creek crossings.

title: Thunderstorm advisory: upstream rain
for_households: Rain upstream can raise the Anilao and Malbasag rivers fast. Riverside residents should stay alert tonight.
for_schools: Delay dismissal until the storm passes.
for_farmers: Avoid crossing rivers with livestock.
for_barangay_officials: Check the diversion channel bridge piers for debris.

title: Flood advisory: Agusan River above normal
for_households: Riverside residents in Baan, Ong Yiu and Bading should keep go-bags ready and be ready to go to the nearest evacuation center if the river rises further.
for_schools: Keep classes in session but prepare to dismiss early if the advisory is upgraded.
for_farmers: Move livestock and stored grain to higher ground.
for_barangay_officials: The Agusan River dike has an open section near Ong Yiu. Station a watcher there and pre-position sandbags and boats.

title: Yellow rainfall warning
for_households: Flooding is possible in low-lying streets. Monitor updates every 3 hours.
for_schools: No change to schedules.
for_farmers: Hold off on fertilizer application until the rain eases.
for_barangay_officials: Clear the clogged inlets on Montilla Boulevard.

title: Thunderstorm advisory
for_households: Heavy rain for 1–2 hours. Avoid crossing flooded streets near the Tumaga River.
for_schools: Delay dismissal until the storm passes.
for_farmers: Check drainage in farm plots near the river.
for_barangay_officials: The Rio Hondo revetment is unfinished. Watch the open section at the river mouth.
